degree_of_substitution: 2 tail-derived CH2 arms per primary NH2 of the amine core: each NH2 becomes a tertiary nitrogen bearing two aminomethylated tail groups. Secondary amine N-H, tertiary N and the amide N-H of a16 are NOT substituted. Evidence: the generic scheme in Supplementary Fig. 1 (R-NH2 -> R-N(CH2X)2 for all five chemistries); the assembled structures in Supplementary Figs. 2-3 and 5-6 (A-a6 and E-a8/E-a9/E-a11 carry 4 arms for 2 NH2; A-a13 and A-a14 carry 6 arms for 3 NH2; A-a12, A-a15, E-a12 and A-a16 carry 4 arms with the internal secondary or amide N-H drawn intact); the Methods C-a16 scale-up at 4.5 mmol phenol : 4.2 mmol formaldehyde : 1.0 mmol a16; and the C-a16 1H NMR, in which the N-CH2-Ar multiplet at 3.86-3.43 integrates for 8H = 4 x CH2 against 12 aromatic H and 12 H of 4 terminal CH3. So degree of substitution = 2 x (number of primary NH2): 2 for a1-a5, 4 for a6-a12 and a15-a16, 6 for a13-a14.
